key: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.
s: Just after an exhortation and a balm for the breasts are announced to mankind, the Prophet is told what to say; al-Tabari, on 10:58, reads the bounty as Islam and the mercy as the Qur’an, together worth more than this world’s wealth and treasure.

evidence.words: ﴿بفضل الله﴾ ، أيها الناس، الذي تفضل به عليكم، وهو الإسلام، فبيَّنه لكم، ودعاكم إليه = ﴿وبرحمته﴾ ، التي رحمكم بها، فأنزلها إليكم، فعلَّمكم ما لم تكونوا تعلمون من كتابه، وبصَّركم بها معالم دينكم، وذلك القرآن = ﴿فبذلك فليفرحوا هو خير مما يجمعون﴾ ، يقول: فإن الإسلام الذي دعاهم إليه، والقرآن الذي أنزله عليهم، خيرٌ مما يجمعون من حُطَام الدنيا وأموالها وكنوزها
evidence.gloss: “In the bounty of God”, O people, with which He has favoured you: that is Islam, which He made plain to you and called you to; “and in His mercy”, with which He had mercy on you and sent down to you, teaching you from His Book what you did not know: that is the Qur’an. “Therein let them rejoice; it is better than what they hoard”: the Islam He called them to and the Qur’an He sent down are better than the debris of this world, its wealth and its treasures, that they amass.

reason: The problem holds: two subjects (an exhortation and a balm) took the singular is announced. Changed is to are and nothing else. Re-opened day.js: 10:57 addresses mankind (There hath come unto you an exhortation ..., a balm for that which is in the breasts), and 10:58 opens with Say, so the context clause stands. Re-opened packet.js quran 23 --verse 10.58: al-Tabari’s own gloss (qala Abu Ja’far) makes the bounty Islam and the mercy the Qur’an, jointly better than the debris of this world, its wealth and treasures; the evidence words re-found verbatim by machine. verse.js ok (Yunus 10:58, at 1421); entry-check ok, 44 words.
